# Leopoldo<br>Catania[.]{.name-dot}

::: {.role tag="p"}
Associate Professor of Econometrics
:::

::: {.intro tag="p"}
I work on time-series analysis, financial econometrics, latent class models, and quantitative risk management.
:::

::: {.bio tag="p"}
I am an Associate Professor in the Department of Economics and Business Economics at Aarhus University. My research develops models and methods for understanding changing distributions, volatility, and risk.
:::
